seoTitle: Mesquite ISD Calendar 2025-2026 | Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Mesquite ISD Calendar 2025-2026 with first day, holidays, breaks, early release dates, PDF, ICS download, and important family planning dates.
calendarNotes: Mesquite ISD starts the 2025-2026 school year on August 12, 2025 and ends on May 28, 2026. Thanksgiving Break runs November 24-28, Winter Break runs December 22-January 2, and Spring Break runs March 16-20. The calendar also lists professional learning days, classroom workdays, early release days, school hours, graduation dates, A-day markers, and 226-day personnel workday markers.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Mesquite ISD start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school is Tuesday, August 12, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Mesquite ISD Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 16 through Friday, March 20, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Mesquite ISD in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Thursday, May 28, 2026, and it is marked as an early release day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Mesquite ISD Winter Break in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 22, 2025 through Friday, January 2, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Mesquite ISD have early release days in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The district calendar marks December 19, 2025 and May 28, 2026 as early release days for all schools.

calendarFaqs.q: How do I add the Mesquite ISD calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Download the Mesquite ISD ICS calendar file from this page, open Google Calendar, choose Import, upload the ICS file, and confirm the imported dates. The file is a one-time calendar import, not a live district sync.

customSections.label: Mesquite ISD Calendar Overview 2025-2026
customSections.content: The Mesquite ISD 2025-2026 district calendar provides districtwide student dates for family planning. Families can use it to track the first day of school, student and staff holidays, professional learning days, classroom workdays, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, early release days, graduation dates, school hours, A-day markers, and the last day of school.

customSections.label: Mesquite ISD Early Release Times 2025-2026
customSections.content: The official calendar lists early release times by school level: elementary schools release at 12:25 p.m., middle schools release at 12:45 p.m., high schools release at 1:05 p.m., and Vanguard releases at 1:35 p.m. Families should confirm campus procedures before relying on pickup or transportation plans.

customSections.label: How We Verify Mesquite ISD Calendar Dates
customSections.content:
MySchoolDates reviews the official Mesquite ISD calendar page and published district calendar PDF, compares key dates such as first day, last day, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, holidays, professional learning days, classroom workdays, early release days, graduation dates, and school hours, then converts the reviewed records into the calendar file used on this page.

The official Mesquite ISD calendar remains the source of record for revisions, campus-specific events, testing windows, emergency closures, and same-day announcements.
